tools.name: System Time
tools.description: Return the current system time in ISO format.

tools.name: Math Eval
tools.description: Safely evaluate a math expression.

tools.name: Read File
tools.description: Read a text file from the workspace. Paths can be relative (e.g., 'file.txt' or 'data/file.txt') or workspace-rooted format (e.g., 'workspace:/file.txt'). Both formats are handled automatically.

tools.name: Write File
tools.description: Write a text file to the workspace. Paths can be relative (e.g., 'file.txt' or 'data/file.txt') or workspace-rooted format (e.g., 'workspace:/file.txt'). Both formats are handled automatically.

tools.name: Analyze an existing image
tools.description: Answer a question about an existing image. Does not capture the desktop or camera. Use the exact image_ref supplied by the user or returned by an image producer.

input.question: What is the text on the sign?

not_for: reading a video title in a browser window
tools.name: Video Analyse
tools.description: Analyse a video by adaptively sampling frames over time, transcribing audio, and returning a structured summary, direct answer, OCR text, detected objects, transcript, and a keyframe timeline.

output.transcript: Speaker says hello and points to a chart.

tools.name: Observe live camera frames
tools.description: Analyze frames from the configured CAMERA broker. Requires an active camera stream. Cannot see desktop windows, monitors, or browser content; use computer.screenshot then image.analyse for those.

input.question: Read the text in front of you.

tools.name: Locate a clickable UI element
tools.description: Find the clickable center of a named UI element in an existing screenshot. Returns screen-pixel x/y coordinates for computer.click. Use this for buttons, links, fields, icons, menus, and other visual desktop targets; image.analyse does not return reliable click coordinates.
use_for: find a button or icon in a screenshot

tools.name: Capture desktop screen
tools.description: Capture the current desktop screen or a region and save it to the workspace. Before visual clicking on Wayland, set prepare_input=true to grant desktop control before capturing. Use a full screenshot for click coordinates.

prepare_input.description: Grant Wayland portal input control before the screenshot; ignored on X11 and Windows.

tools.name: Computer Click
tools.description: Click the desktop pointer at known screen-pixel coordinates. If the user did not supply x/y, first capture a fresh screenshot and use ui.predict_coords; never ask image.analyse for click coordinates or guess them.

requires.when: x and y were not explicitly supplied by the user

tools.name: Computer Move
tools.description: Move the desktop pointer to screen coordinates.

tools.name: Computer Drag
tools.description: Drag the desktop pointer between screen coordinates.

tools.name: Computer Type
tools.description: Type text into the currently focused desktop application.

tools.name: Computer Hotkey
tools.description: Press a keyboard shortcut in the currently focused desktop application.

tools.name: Computer Scroll
tools.description: Scroll the currently focused desktop application.

tools.name: Computer Focus Window
tools.description: Focus a desktop window whose title contains the supplied text.

tools.name: Computer Launch Application
tools.description: Launch a desktop application without invoking a shell.

tools.name: SymPy Evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate and simplify symbolic math expressions using SymPy.

tools.name: List Directory
tools.description: List files and directories under a workspace path.

tools.name: Delete Path
tools.description: Delete a file or directory inside the workspace.

tools.name: Move Path
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory inside the workspace.

tools.name: Copy Path
tools.description: Copy a file or directory inside the workspace.

tools.name: Make Directory
tools.description: Create a directory inside the workspace. Paths can be relative (e.g., 'tmp' or 'data/subdir') or workspace-rooted format (e.g., 'workspace:/tmp'). Both formats are handled automatically.

tools.name: Web Search (SearXNG)
tools.description: Search the web using a SearXNG instance.

tools.name: Google Status
tools.description: Inspect Google Workspace OAuth configuration and authorized scope bundles.

tools.name: Google Authorize
tools.description: Run the installed-app OAuth flow for a predefined Google scope bundle.

tools.name: Google Disconnect
tools.description: Remove locally stored OAuth credentials for one Google bundle or all bundles.

tools.name: Google Gmail List Messages
tools.description: List Gmail messages matching a search query.

tools.name: Google Gmail Get Message
tools.description: Fetch a Gmail message by id.

tools.name: Google Gmail Create Draft
tools.description: Create a Gmail draft message.

tools.name: Google Gmail Send Message
tools.description: Send an email through Gmail.

tools.name: Google Calendar List Events
tools.description: List Google Calendar events from a calendar.

tools.name: Google Calendar Create Event
tools.description: Create an event in Google Calendar.

tools.name: Google Docs Get Document
tools.description: Read a Google Docs document by document id.

tools.name: Google Docs Create Document
tools.description: Create a Google Docs document and optionally seed it with content.

tools.name: Google Docs Append Text
tools.description: Append text to the end of a Google Docs document.

tools.name: List Tools
tools.description: List the currently registered tools and their metadata.

tools.name: File Stat
tools.description: Inspect whether a workspace path exists and return basic metadata. Paths can be relative (e.g., 'file.txt' or 'data/subdir') or workspace-rooted format (e.g., 'workspace:/file.txt'). Both formats are handled automatically.

tools.name: Find Files
tools.description: Search the workspace tree by glob and optional regex filters.

tools.name: Search Text
tools.description: Search text content within workspace files and return matching lines.

tools.name: JSON Query
tools.description: Read a JSON file and optionally resolve a JSON Pointer within it.

tools.name: CSV Read
tools.description: Read rows from a CSV file in the workspace.

tools.name: Create Zip Archive
tools.description: Create a zip archive from workspace files and directories.

tools.name: Extract Zip Archive
tools.description: Extract a zip archive into the workspace with zip-slip protection.

tools.name: HTTP Request
tools.description: Perform an HTTP or HTTPS request and optionally save the response into the workspace.

tools.name: Git Status
tools.description: Return the current git branch summary and changed files for a workspace repository.

tools.name: Git Diff
tools.description: Return a git diff for the workspace repository.

tools.name: Git Log
tools.description: Return recent git commits for the workspace repository.

tools.name: Process Exec
tools.description: Execute a local process without a shell, capturing stdout and stderr.
